title: Grateful Dead Live at Roscoe Maples Pavilion, Stanford on 1973-02-09
source: Recording Info: MR > R (Bob Menke) > R (Pat Lee); Transfer Info: Technics 1506 w/Lamb Labs Dolby decoder > WAV (24bit/96k) > Apogee Mini Me 24/96 > Apogee Mini DAC monitoring and mastering > FLAC; Mastered By Matt Smith

ai_review.summary: Soundboard recording is a bit patchy, but the show shines with killer jams like Deal, Sugaree, and an 18‑minute Eyes sequence.
ai_review.review: The performance captures the Dead in a rehearsal‑like mood of early ’73, delivering strong renditions of Deal, Me & My Uncle, Sugaree and a marathon Truckin > Eyes > China Doll jam. While the audio is uneven – fat and lively at times yet noticeably unbalanced and noisy – the musical moments more than compensate for the technical flaws.

ai_rating.rationale: Both reviewers gave 4‑star scores; they praise many songs and overall musicianship while noting a patchy, unbalanced SBD recording.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Fat, lively mix with clear vocals on some tracks but generally unbalanced and noisy; tape is described as 'patchy' and 'messy', never quite getting balanced throughout.

standout_songs: Truckin > Eyes > China Doll (18‑min Eyes jam)
show_quality.setlist_flow: First set feels like a rehearsal with many new tunes and experimental jams; second set builds into long, exploratory sequences (China > Rider, Truckin/Eyes) giving the concert a loose but exciting flow.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia shreds on Me & My Uncle, throws licks everywhere, and delivers pristine vocals on Sugaree.
band_member_comments.Phil: Phil's bass is described as 'fat' and thunderous on L.L.R., and he even takes lead vocals on Mexicali.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keith finally appears in the mix, adding depth to the keyboard texture.
